newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares fall ahead of SBI results.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares fall ahead of SBI results.

text.p: Delhi shares reversed course to drift lower in cautious afternoon trade as investors stayed largely on the sidelines ahead of the announcement of State Bank of India's (SBI) results later on Thursday, brokers said.
Steel maker TISCO bucked the trend, surging 4.45 rupees to 197 on heavy orders by foreign institutional investors (FIIs) and speculators, dealers said.
By 12:45 p.m. (0715 GMT), the Delhi Stock Exchange's Sensitive Index was down 4.40 points at 853.55. In early trade it had touched 859.97.
